verses.original: Τότε Φαρισαῖοι καὶ γραμματεῖς προσέρχονται τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: Tote Pharisaioi kai grammateis proserchontai tō Iēsou apo Hierosolymōn legontes
verses.literal: Then [some] Pharisees and scribes came - to Jesus from Jerusalem [and] asked

verses.original: Διὰ τί σου οἱ μαθηταί παραβαίνουσιν τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων γὰρ οὐ νίπτονται αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ὅταν ἐσθίωσιν ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: Dia ti sou hoi mathētai parabainousin tēn paradosin tōn presbyterōn gar ou niptontai autōn tas cheiras hotan esthiōsin arton
verses.literal: Why {do} . . . Your - disciples break the tradition of the elders - vvv They do not wash their - hands before they eat . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ Διὰ τί ὑμεῖς παραβαίνετε τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ ὑμῶν τὴν παράδοσιν
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen autois kai Dia ti hymeis parabainete tēn entolēn tou Theou dia hymōn tēn paradosin
verses.literal: - - [Jesus] replied . . . . . . And why . . . {do} you break the command - of God for the sake of your - tradition

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς εἶπεν Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καί Ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos eipen Tima ton patera kai tēn mētera kai Ho kakologōn patera ē mētera thanatō teleutatō
verses.literal: For - God said Honor [your] father and - mother and Anyone who curses [his] father or mother vvv must be put to death

verses.original: δὲ ὑμεῖς λέγετε Ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί ὃ ἐὰν ὠφεληθῇς ἐξ ἐμοῦ Δῶρον
verses.transliteration: de hymeis legete Hos an eipē tō patri ē tē mētri ho ean ōphelēthēs ex emou Dōron
verses.literal: But you say that if anyone . . . says to [his] father or - mother Whatever vvv you would have received from me is a gift devoted [to God]

verses.original: οὐ μὴ τιμήσει αὐτοῦ τὸν πατέρα ἢ αὐτοῦ τὴν μητέρα καὶ ἠκυρώσατε τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ ὑμῶν τὴν παράδοσιν
verses.transliteration: ou mē timēsei autou ton patera ē autou tēn mētera kai ēkyrōsate ton logon tou Theou dia hymōn tēn paradosin
verses.literal: vvv vvv he need not honor his - father or - - mother [with it] Thus you nullify the word - of God for the sake of your - tradition

verses.original: ὑποκριταί Ἠσαΐας ἐπροφήτευσεν καλῶς περὶ ὑμῶν λέγων
verses.transliteration: hypokritai Ēsaias eprophēteusen kalōs peri hymōn legōn
verses.literal: You hypocrites Isaiah prophesied correctly about you -

verses.original: οὗτος Ὁ λαὸς τιμᾷ με τοῖς χείλεσίν δὲ αὐτῶν Ἡ καρδία ἀπέχει πόρρω ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos Ho laos tima me tois cheilesin de autōn Hē kardia apechei porrō ap’ emou
verses.literal: These - people honor Me with their lips but their - hearts are far . . . from Me

verses.original: δὲ σέβονταί με Μάτην Διδάσκοντες διδασκαλίας ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: de sebontai me Matēn Didaskontes didaskalias entalmata anthrōpōn
verses.literal: - They worship Me in vain they teach [as] doctrine [the] precepts of men

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀκούετε καὶ συνίετε
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos ton ochlon eipen autois Akouete kai syniete
verses.literal: - [Jesus] called the crowd [to Him] [and] said - Listen and understand

verses.original: τὸν ἄνθρωπον κοινοῖ οὐ τὸ εἰσερχόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα ἀλλὰ τοῦτο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος
verses.transliteration: ton anthrōpon koinoi ou to eiserchomenon eis to stoma alla touto koinoi ton anthrōpon to ekporeuomenon ek tou stomatos
verses.literal: A man is not defiled . . . by what enters . . . [his] mouth but - - - - by what comes out of - [it]

verses.original: Τότε οἱ μαθηταὶ προσελθόντες αὐτῷ λέγουσιν Οἶδας ὅτι οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἐσκανδαλίσθησαν ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Tote hoi mathētai proselthontes autō legousin Oidas hoti hoi Pharisaioi eskandalisthēsan akousantes ton logon
verses.literal: Then the disciples came to Him [and] said Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this -

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Πᾶσα φυτεία ἣν μου ὁ οὐράνιος ὁ Πατήρ οὐκ ἐφύτευσεν ἐκριζωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen Pasa phyteia hēn mou ho ouranios ho Patēr ouk ephyteusen ekrizōthēsetai
verses.literal: But - [Jesus] replied - Every plant that My - heavenly - Father vvv has not planted will be pulled up by its roots

verses.original: ἄφετε αὐτούς εἰσιν τυφλοί ὁδηγοί τυφλῶν δὲ ἐὰν τυφλὸς ὁδηγῇ τυφλὸν ἀμφότεροι πεσοῦνται εἰς βόθυνον
verses.transliteration: aphete autous eisin typhloi hodēgoi typhlōn de ean typhlos hodēgē typhlon amphoteroi pesountai eis bothynon
verses.literal: Disregard them They are blind guides - - If [a] blind [man] leads [a] blind [man] both will fall into a pit

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Φράσον ταύτην τὴν παραβολήν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: de ho Petros Apokritheis eipen autō Phrason tautēn tēn parabolēn hēmin
verses.literal: - - Peter said . . . to Him Explain this - parable to us

verses.original: ἐστε ὑμεῖς καὶ Ἀκμὴν ἀσύνετοί δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: este hymeis kai Akmēn asynetoi de Ho eipen
verses.literal: Do you vvv still not understand - - [Jesus] asked

verses.original: οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα χωρεῖ εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν καὶ ἐκβάλλεται εἰς ἀφεδρῶνα
verses.transliteration: ou noeite hoti pan to eisporeuomenon eis to stoma chōrei eis tēn koilian kai ekballetai eis aphedrōna
verses.literal: vvv Do you not yet realize that whatever - enters . . . the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ τὰ ἐκπορευόμενα ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς καρδίας κἀκεῖνα κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: de ta ekporeuomena ek tou stomatos exerchetai ek tēs kardias kakeina koinoi ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart and these things defile a man

verses.original: γὰρ ἐκ τῆς καρδίας ἐξέρχονται πονηροί διαλογισμοὶ φόνοι μοιχεῖαι πορνεῖαι κλοπαί ψευδομαρτυρίαι βλασφημίαι
verses.transliteration: gar ek tēs kardias exerchontai ponēroi dialogismoi phonoi moicheiai porneiai klopai pseudomartyriai blasphēmiai
verses.literal: For out of the heart come evil thoughts murder adultery sexual immorality theft false testimony [and] slander

verses.original: ταῦτά ἐστιν τὰ κοινοῦντα τὸν ἄνθρωπον δὲ τὸ φαγεῖν ἀνίπτοις χερσὶν οὐ κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: tauta estin ta koinounta ton anthrōpon de to phagein aniptois chersin ou koinoi ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: These are what defile a man but - eating with unwashed hands vvv does not defile - [him]

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Τύρου καὶ Σιδῶνος
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn ekeithen ho Iēsous anechōrēsen eis ta merē Tyrou kai Sidōnos
verses.literal: - Leaving that place - Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Χαναναία γυνὴ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐκείνων ὁρίων ἐξελθοῦσα ἔκραζεν λέγουσα Κύριε υἱὸς Δαυίδ Ἐλέησόν με μου ἡ θυγάτηρ κακῶς δαιμονίζεται
verses.transliteration: kai idou Chananaia gynē apo tōn ekeinōn horiōn exelthousa ekrazen legousa Kyrie huios Dauid Eleēson me mou hē thygatēr kakōs daimonizetai
verses.literal: And . . . a Canaanite woman from vvv that region came [to Him] crying out - Lord Son of David have mercy on me My - daughter {is} miserably possessed by a demon

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη λόγον αὐτῇ καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ προσελθόντες ἠρώτουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Ἀπόλυσον αὐτήν ὅτι κράζει ὄπισθεν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: de Ho ouk apekrithē logon autē kai autou hoi mathētai proselthontes ērōtoun auton legontes Apolyson autēn hoti krazei opisthen hēmōn
verses.literal: But - vvv [Jesus] did not answer a word - So His - disciples came [and] urged Him - Send her away . . . for she keeps crying out after us

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἀπεστάλην εἰ μὴ εἰς τὰ τὰ ἀπολωλότα πρόβατα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen Ouk apestalēn ei mē eis ta ta apolōlota probata oikou Israēl
verses.literal: - - He answered . . . vvv I was sent only . . . to the - lost sheep of [the] house of Israel

verses.original: δὲ Ἡ ἐλθοῦσα προσεκύνει αὐτῷ Κύριε βοήθει μοι λέγουσα
verses.transliteration: de Hē elthousa prosekynei autō Kyrie boēthei moi legousa
verses.literal: - - [The woman] came [and] knelt before Him Lord help me she said

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ἔστιν Οὐκ καλὸν λαβεῖν τὸν τῶν τέκνων ἄρτον καὶ βαλεῖν τοῖς κυναρίοις
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis eipen estin Ouk kalon labein ton tōn teknōn arton kai balein tois kynariois
verses.literal: But - [Jesus] replied - It is not right to take the - children’s bread and toss [it] to the dogs

verses.original: Ναί κύριε δὲ Ἡ εἶπεν γὰρ καὶ τὰ κυνάρια ἐσθίει ἀπὸ τῶν ψιχίων τῶν πιπτόντων ἀπὸ αὐτῶν τῶν κυρίων τῆς τραπέζης
verses.transliteration: Nai kyrie de Hē eipen gar kai ta kynaria esthiei apo tōn psichiōn tōn piptontōn apo autōn tōn kyriōn tēs trapezēs
verses.literal: Yes Lord - - she said - even the dogs eat - the crumbs - that fall from their - master’s - table

verses.original: Ὦ γύναι Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῇ σου ἡ πίστις μεγάλη γενηθήτω σοι ὡς θέλεις καὶ αὐτῆς ἡ θυγάτηρ ἰάθη ἀπὸ τῆς ἐκείνης ὥρας
verses.transliteration: Ō gynai Tote ho Iēsous apokritheis eipen autē sou hē pistis megalē genēthētō soi hōs theleis kai autēs hē thygatēr iathē apo tēs ekeinēs hōras
verses.literal: O woman - - Jesus answered . . . . . . your - faith is great Let it be done for you as you desire And her - daughter was healed from that very hour

verses.original: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἀναβὰς εἰς τὸ ὄρος ἐκάθητο ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai metabas ekeithen ho Iēsous ēlthen para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias kai anabas eis to oros ekathēto ekei
verses.literal: - Moving on from there - Jesus went along the Sea - of Galilee Then He went up on - a mountain [and] sat down

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ὄχλοι προσῆλθον αὐτῷ ἔχοντες μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν χωλούς τυφλούς κυλλούς κωφούς καὶ πολλούς ἑτέρους καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτοὺς παρὰ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai polloi ochloi prosēlthon autō echontes meth’ heautōn chōlous typhlous kyllous kōphous kai pollous heterous kai erripsan autous para autou tous podas kai etherapeusen autous
verses.literal: - Large crowds came to Him bringing . . . . . . [the] lame [the] blind [the] crippled [the] mute and many others and laid them at His - feet and He healed them

verses.original: ὥστε τὸν ὄχλον θαυμάσαι βλέποντας κωφοὺς λαλοῦντας κυλλοὺς ὑγιεῖς καὶ χωλοὺς περιπατοῦντας καὶ τυφλοὺς βλέποντας καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν Θεὸν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: hōste ton ochlon thaumasai blepontas kōphous lalountas kyllous hygieis kai chōlous peripatountas kai typhlous blepontas kai edoxasan ton Theon Israēl
verses.literal: - The crowd was amazed when they saw [the] mute speaking [the] crippled restored - [the] lame walking and [the] blind seeing And they glorified the God of Israel

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοῦ τοὺς μαθητὰς εἶπεν Σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον ὅτι προσμένουσίν ἤδη μοι τρεῖς ἡμέραι καὶ ἔχουσιν οὐκ τί φάγωσιν καὶ οὐ θέλω ἀπολῦσαι αὐτοὺς νήστεις μή‿ ποτε ἐκλυθῶσιν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous proskalesamenos autou tous mathētas eipen Splanchnizomai epi ton ochlon hoti prosmenousin ēdē moi treis hēmerai kai echousin ouk ti phagōsin kai ou thelō apolysai autous nēsteis mē pote eklythōsin en tē hodō
verses.literal: Then - Jesus called His - disciples [to Him] [and] said I have compassion for [this] crowd because they have already been . . . with Me three days and have nothing - to eat - vvv I do not want to send them away . . . hungry vvv or they may faint along the way

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ μαθηταί λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Πόθεν ἐν ἐρημίᾳ ἡμῖν τοσοῦτοι ἄρτοι ὥστε χορτάσαι τοσοῦτον ὄχλον
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi mathētai legousin autō Pothen en erēmia hēmin tosoutoi artoi hōste chortasai tosouton ochlon
verses.literal: - The disciples replied - Where in this desolate place could we [find] enough bread vvv to feed such a large crowd

verses.original: Πόσους ἄρτους ἔχετε Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἑπτά δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν καὶ ὀλίγα ἰχθύδια
verses.transliteration: Posous artous echete Kai ho Iēsous legei autois Hepta de Hoi eipan kai oliga ichthydia
verses.literal: How many loaves do you have - - Jesus asked - Seven - - they replied and a few small fish

verses.original: Καὶ παραγγείλας τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Kai parangeilas tō ochlō anapesein epi tēn gēn
verses.literal: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground

verses.original: ἔλαβεν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς ἰχθύας καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις
verses.transliteration: elaben tous hepta artous kai tous ichthyas kai eucharistēsas eklasen kai edidou tois mathētais de hoi mathētai tois ochlois
verses.literal: Taking the seven loaves and the fish - He gave thanks [and] broke [them] Then He gave [them] to [the] disciples and the disciples [gave them] to the people

verses.original: Καὶ πάντες ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν καὶ ἦραν ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας πλήρεις τῶν κλασμάτων τὸ περισσεῦον
verses.transliteration: Kai pantes ephagon kai echortasthēsan kai ēran hepta spyridas plēreis tōn klasmatōn to perisseuon
verses.literal: - They all ate and were satisfied and [the disciples] picked up seven basketfuls . . . - of broken pieces that were left over

verses.original: οἱ δὲ τετρακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες ἦσαν ἐσθίοντες χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων
verses.transliteration: hoi de tetrakischilioi andres ēsan esthiontes chōris gynaikōn kai paidiōn
verses.literal: A total of . . . four thousand men were fed besides women and children

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἐνέβη εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια Μαγαδάν
verses.transliteration: Kai apolysas tous ochlous enebē eis to ploion kai ēlthen eis ta horia Magadan
verses.literal: After [Jesus] had dismissed the crowds He got into . . . the boat and went to the region of Magadan
